scenario: Mistwake Treno Catoblepas, Machinist Duty Support
distance: Horizontal centre separation minus 0.5y player and 4.5y boss hitboxes; clamped to zero
method: Seed boss pose from OpCreate and use each actor's latest preceding OpMove at each sample. Compare matched local OpActionRequest and player OpCastEvent by action ID/source sequence. GCD IDs come from native MCH action definitions.

spacing.method: Latest recorded OpMove for each actor at 250ms intervals, boss OpCreate seeds stationary pose, subtract player and target hitboxes; first-boss local combat interval. Not mechanic-adjusted.

limitations: First-boss comparison, not whole-role or migration acceptance.
No normalization for mechanic movement or exact pattern differences.
After recording has an incomplete compressed tail later at 14:27:01 UTC; the complete first-boss window precedes that tail.
GCD request cadence and matched effects are not a potency/damage comparison or server snapshot proof.
